item_name: Rothco Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket
item_short_desc: Defend yourself against the toughest weather with the Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket. As part of Rothco’s rugged Soft Shell outerwear series, the tactical military jacket features our Soft Shell waterproof 3-layer fabric system that deflects wind, retains heat, and releases moisture. description: Defend yourself against the toughest weather with the Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket. As part of Rothco’s rugged Soft Shell outerwear series, the tactical military jacket features our Soft Shell waterproof 3-layer fabric system that deflects wind, retains heat, and releases moisture. The high-performance fabric helps protect and keep you comfortable while braving the elements. This versatile coat is great for military personnel, tactical professionals, and outdoor enthusiasts. Comfortable Fleece Lining: The insulated jacket features a soft fleece lining that keeps you warm, ideal for cold weather tactical operations and outdoor adventures. The fleece-lined collar features a removable stowaway hood and provides additional protection. High-Capacity Storage: The military soft shell jacket comes equipped with 8 tactical zipper pockets: 2 shoulder pockets, 2 chest pockets, 2 internal pockets, 1 back pocket, and 1 arm pocket for storing tactical gear and outdoor essentials. Utility at the Forefront: The tactical soft shell jacket features underarm ventilation zippers that ensure optimal comfort by allowing air circulation. The drawstring waist and adjustable elastic wrist cuffs provide a perfect fit, while the two-way zipper offers quick and easy access. In addition, the 2 shoulder loop fields allow you to easily wear patches. Action Ready: From the field to the forest, the military-styled soft shell coat offers exceptional utility and warmth that is great for tactical missions, camping, hiking, hunting, fishing, and casual everyday wear.
